quotes: 이것도 GH에게 전달해서 sh4에게 task 진행하도록 시키자. 이전 memit writer에 이어서 pending 걸어놓으면 됨.
alphaedit writer로도 실험을 해볼 가치가 있어 보인다. 3개 arm 2개 모델 올리는 실험 검토해봐. 기대효과도 간단하게 생각해보자
user_authority.scope: 새 AlphaEdit 6개 cold 2k의 구현/source freeze/Slurm held검사/release/실행/collector를 승인. 기존 STOP의 scoped exception은 이 task뿐. 단계별 재승인 없음.

canonical.precedence: 최신 USER + authorized-run-contract + 본 resource/delivery envelope. 원문 exact bytes 보존. review NOT_DISPATCHED 및 fe7c/0415 기준은 역사적 검토이며 현재 구현 기준/실행금지가 아님.

predecessor.current_scheduler_status: GH_NOT_QUERIED; SH4 must bind fresh owner/dependency/accounting for admission

queue_contract.requirement: AlphaEdit GPU는 MEMIT 여섯 run 모두 종료 후 시작. 두 tail이 모든 선행 GPU를 cover하는 실제 afterany graph인지 확인; 아니면 실제 전체 frontier로 수정하고 receipt. terminal/aged-out는 정확 accounting+submission으로 결속하고 추측하지 않음.
queue_contract.lane_edges: 첫 cell 양쪽 모두 common frontier; 같은 model 후속은 afterany 직전 Alpha cell. CPU collector는 own six afterany/GPU0.
queue_contract.known_common_technical_fault: 공통 기술 결함이 실제 확인되면 원인/영향범위를 기록해 해당 후속만 보류; 선행 과학 음성/실패 자체를 독립 cold arm의 성능 gate로 쓰지 않음.
queue_contract.registration: 구현/정적검사/source freeze 후 추가승인 없이 여섯 run 전량 held검사/release. free GPU 대기 대신 scheduler dependency. 미제출이면 task pending으로 보고하고 jobID 비움.

implementation.base: 현재 repaired source87a5a736 + latest main의 해당 구현을 채택. fe7c/0415로 되돌리지 않음. 원 MEMIT frozen source/config/archive/job/raw 보존.
implementation.primary: 새 project/run_scripts/jlz_price_alpha_writer/** 또는 task-local adapter/entry/submit/collector. 아래 공유 모듈의 writer dispatch/LOO/diagnostic 연결만 backward-compatible, MEMIT defaults 불변.
implementation.planner: LR.1/KL.0625/norm.5, EfficiencyAdam absolute R/기존 active mask, FP32 model·FP64geometry,25eval24update,grace12/4stage/F.05. nativec=.75/maxscale=.75; beta_max=max(beta_base,.75*pi_max). FREE100은 진짜 uncapped/null. common endpoint/tiny repair 보존.
implementation.writer: lambda_alpha=1; A=lambda I+N(H+KK^T), Q=solve(A,NK), DeltaW=R Q^T, M=Q^T K. fixed .02 projector를 current asset SHA/shape/physical layer로 결속. A0=lambda I+NH는 비대칭: LU layer/batch당1회, Y=solve(A0,NK), Q=Y solve(I+K^T Y); candidate dense factor/SVD 반복0. actual operator residual로 방향/order 확인. FP64 geometry를 stock FP32 bitwise라고 주장하지 않음.
implementation.consistent_paths: fresh actual lower write→upper keys, BUILD/own-entry 가격/raw-context same-layer full off-owner pullback/terminal exact FP32 payload가 동일 Alpha Q. final rewrite mean H once, zero/미달 요청 포함. no dK/dQ/full-builder reverse.
implementation.price: X[r,j]=(a_r/a_j)M[r,j]/(1-M[j,j]), offdiag RMS/floor/minlayer. own-entry freeze each batch. Alpha LOO=(lambda I+NH)q_minus+N K_minus(K_minus^T q_minus)-N k_r. MEMIT 가격/LOO식 재사용금지. guard 원계약, clip/jitter/inverse compensation 없음.
implementation.diagnostics: Q_C0=tr(DeltaW C0 DeltaW^T), Q_H=tr(DeltaW H DeltaW^T)를 직접 분리. nonsymmetric A0를 energy로 쓰거나 total-Q_H로 C0 추정0. C0 scale 명시. ||Nk||/||k||,Mrr,weak-actuation/leakage,requested/realized 및 denominator 기록.
implementation.forbidden: 15000 C0 hybrid/posthoc MEMIT update projection/stock compute_z residual/divisor/tracking/exact forcing/Qwen baseline lr.5 clamp4/orthogonal basis 교체 없음.

models.fresh_binding: Both exact runtime/config/tokenizer/native context/C0/projector evaluator/source/rows/current assets. existing full-SHA receipts+currentstat may safely reuse as protocol permits; wrong identity blocks, new large transfer/rebuild requires exact need report.

resources.count_scope: MEMIT+Alpha+기존 해당 사용자 모든 server4 GPU 및 GPU준비/검산 합산. stricter current policy 적용; cap증가/타job선점0.
resources.admission: 새 projector+LU/thin geometry+runtime+SDK sidecar 전체 peak budget; current node/queue/host/VRAM/disk/inode/reserve 확인. N CPU/mmap/stream 허용. 3.83/6.68GiB는 N payload일뿐 전체추가VRAM 아님.
resources.held_inspection: exact owner/fullargv/job name/source/config/input/projector/W&B/noCP/resources/dependencies+cap proof 후 release. existing predecessor/jobs mutation0. authoritative actual submit IDs only.

validation.preflight: 생산코드/AST/import/CLI/config/source/method 구현 검토 및 dependency/identity/cap 정합 최소점검. 과거 CPU/GPU evidence를 새 Alpha actual PASS로 승계하지 않음.
validation.actual_B1: 이미 계산하는 tensor/proposal에 original Alpha operator residual/LOO/endpoint ZERO CAP ties/FP64 KKT/FP32 feasibility/counters/accepted payload/commit/H once 검산 통합. 같은 trajectory 계속, tolerance 사후완화0.

evaluation.schedule: current pre/post; W0/W5/W10/W15/W20 allseen + fixedfirst500/birth/active; final R2000/P4000/N20000.
evaluation.metrics: RS/PS/NS, TFtoken/prompt/strict ACC, true/new NLL/margin, pairedlost/gained/acquisition/retention; price rawkappa/floor/ties/lowestlayer, exactzero/endpoint/tiny separated; stage/ownupdates/base-max-currentbeta/spend-slack/cap/support-reentry/defined ratio counts; Q_C0/Q_H/update norm/exclusive times/hostVRAM.
evaluation.W0reuse: only exact model/runtime/token/row identity matched, model内のみ
evaluation.comparison: 対応MEMIT model×arm/同じcohort endpoint。runtime/identity differencesと missing/pending明示。期待PS改善を結果として述べない。SH factual, GH interpretation.

tracking.helper: project/run_scripts/experiment_tracking/** SH1 owner read-only, current predecessor caller reuse
tracking.privacy: scalar whitelist only, no credentials/rawtensor/prompts/code/git/console/watch/CP uploads. new model/writer/arm/job/source/URL exact identity; no key in args/Git/messages.
tracking.failure: startup online check, midrun network localspool/degraded per policy; no extra scientific replay. host sidecar included in resource budget.

artifacts.storage: 六run logs/eval/SDKspool/temp/receipt reserves+batch boundary check。single authoritative candidate stream+summary/hash, no duplicate dump, no unrelated deletion.
artifacts.git: source/compact report/manifest only, original proposal bytes unchanged; no reset/stash/stage-all/force push
artifacts.broadcast: approved ordinary exact allowlist/no --delete only when needed; NO_BROADCAST_NOT_REQUIRED with reason. secrets/env/SDKspool excluded.

allowed_write_paths: dedicated WT ignored servers/local/session-boundary.env and nonsecret task-local config
shared_change_limit: listed shared files only Alpha writer factor/backend/price-LOO/diagnostics switch preserving current corrected MEMIT behavior and frozen bytes. Further indispensable shared path report exact need before expansion, no general refactor.
delivery: 同nonce duplicate確認→明示 ownerACK+accepted turn+task pending登録(先行frontier/未登録IDs空)を先に返す。以降GH返信/追加USER承認待たず実装/六jobs登録継続。queue receipt可能時事実報告。
monitoring: GH bounded ownerACK/possible queue receipt only. SH4 release後単1回resource snapshotでhandoff; no new recurring monitor/heartbeat/automaticretry/全main完了待機。sealed20batch+collectorは自然進行、別途recallまでagentpollingなし。
